content.text: CLEC9A is a highly specific marker for conventional dendritic cells type 1 (cDC1), and combined with CPVL, WDFY4, and abundant MHC class II genes (CD74, HLA-DPA1, HLA-DPB1, HLA-DRA, HLA-DQB1), this strongly points to a dendritic cell population, specifically the CLEC9A+ cDC1 subset.
